visual.observation: The opening frames display the claims "Best Plateform" and "Almost 2 lakh only in 4 months" over a phone screen, alongside "Power Of OnlineBusiness."
visual.context: Promotional context is visually suggested by the repeated platform-superlative and earnings text; the particular service shown on the phone is not legible enough to identify.
visual.potential_relevance: A stated earnings amount and timeframe are presented together with an endorsement-style claim for an online-business platform, which may merit review of the basis and conditions of that return claim.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show the currency for "2 lakh," eligibility requirements, any payment or transfer, or whether the displayed figure is an actual verified outcome.

visual.observation: A Forsage-branded interface shows a personal link with a Copy button, an "My xQore invite link" row with a View button, profits of "40.7 BUSD," and program notifications including "+ 10 BUSD received" and "+ 5 BUSD received."
visual.context: The visible interface appears to present program earnings and invite-link navigation; no completed sharing, invitation, payment, or receipt by a viewer is shown.
visual.potential_relevance: The interface pairs displayed BUSD earnings and program-receipt notifications with visible personal/invite links, creating an observable relationship between a potential recruitment/navigation mechanism and stated returns that may merit review of the program conditions.
visual.limitations: The samples do not establish what action generated the displayed amounts, whether an invitation is required for earnings, whether any funds were transferred, or whether the interface reflects a live account.

visual.observation: A Forsage profile preview for "Khani$#" displays a personal link, an xQore invite-link row, zero BUSD profits, zero partners, zero team, and a 0% ratio.
visual.context: This is an interface/profile-preview display rather than observable evidence that an invitation was sent or accepted.
visual.potential_relevance: The visible profile includes an invite-link destination within the same program interface in which earnings are displayed elsewhere, which may be relevant to assessing whether recruitment is part of the shown program flow.
visual.limitations: This frame does not show an earnings promise, the conditions of the link, a recruitment outcome, or any payment.

visual_context_notes.observation: Later frames show motivational text encouraging viewers to "start" and "WORK FOTITY" after saying "So stop Giving excuses."

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes Forsage as an income opportunity, pairing the creator's claimed daily earnings and a claim of nearly two lakh in four months with a personal invite link and dashboard fields for partners and team. The invitation and earnings framing encourage participation in a team-based earning structure, rather than presenting the platform as a warning or neutral demonstration.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the promotional dashboard explicitly presents an invite link alongside partner and team counts, while the video's earnings claims frame participation as an income opportunity. The sampled evidence supports a team-linked recruitment pitch, though it does not show the precise commission formula or establish any completed payout.
